property_summary: For every nonempty list of recipient addresses, calling transfer(from, token, tos, v) must succeed and must cause the token contract to receive exactly tos.length transferFrom(from, tos[i], v) calls; the mutant breaks this because with an empty list it returns true without making any transferFrom call.
change_summary: Delete the require on line 6, so the function no longer reverts on an empty _tos array.
